title: Generation of a Simplified Three-Dimensional Skin-on-a-chip Model in a Micromachined Microfluidic Platform
protocol: Design the microfluidic chip layers with FreeCAD.
Include four 2.54 mm diameter holes in the design for alignment.
Cut 95 μm-thick, adhesive, transparent vinyl sheets into 30 cm x 30 cm squares.
Create a 30 cm x 30 cm workspace in Brother CanvasWorkspace software.
Fill the workspace with designed patterns for chip layers and store as .svg file.
Stick the vinyl sheet to a low-tack adhesive mat, eliminating air bubbles if necessary.
Upload the .svg file to the plotter.
Set cutting parameters: blade level 3, pressure level 0, speed level 1.
Place the adhesive mat with vinyl into the plotter.
Start the cutting process.
Cut the top channel pattern on 12 μm-thick double-sided tape vinyl following previous steps.
Mix the PDMS and curing agent in a ratio of 10:1 (v/v).
Place the mixture under vacuum for 15 min to remove air bubbles.
Pour 55 mL of the mixture into a 55 cm² square culture dish to obtain a 2 mm-thick layer.
Remove bubbles with a needle.
Cure the mixture in an oven for 1 h at 80 °C.
Unmold the PDMS and cut it into rectangles with the chip dimensions.
Make holes for the tubing with an 18 G syringe needle.
Add ten vinyl layers with the upper chamber design.
Stick a double-sided tape vinyl layer with the top-channel pattern on top.
Remove the chip from the aligner and stick it onto the glass slide.
Place a 2-mm-thick PDMS sheet on top of the double-sided tape vinyl layer.
Leave a weight on top of the chip overnight to ensure watertightness.
Sterilize the chip by flushing with 70% v/v ethanol for 5 min.
Wash the chip with distilled H2O.
Connect Pump 1 to Upper Chamber Inlet 1 (UCi1).
Connect Pump 2 to Upper Chamber Inlet 2 (UCi2).
Connect Pump 3 to Lower Chamber Inlet (LCi).
Connect Upper Chamber Outlet (UCo) and Lower Chamber Outlet (LCo) to a waste tube.
Connect the syringes to each inlet using polytetrafluoroethylene tubes.
Use 18 G stainless steel connectors for all connections.
Thaw H2B-GFP-HaCaT cells and GFP-human primary fibroblasts at 37 °C.
Add 2 mL of culture medium to the thawed cells.
Centrifuge the cell mixture for 7 min at 20 °C.
Set the centrifugation speed to 250 × g.
Culture H2B-GFP-HaCaT cells and GFP-hFBs in 1x DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% antibiotic/antimycotic solution.
Pre-warm the culture medium at 37 °C before use.
Wash the cells with 1x phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Add 2 mL of trypsin/ethylenediamine tetraacetic acid (EDTA) and incubate for 10 min at 37 °C.
Inactivate trypsin by adding 4 mL of culture medium.
Resuspend the cells, and transfer them to a 15 mL tube.
Remove 10 μL to count cells on a Neubauer chamber.
Centrifuge the 15 mL tube for 7 min at 20 °C at 250 × g.
Remove the supernatant, and resuspend hFBs at 50,000 cells/mL and H2B-GFP-HaCaT cells at 5×10^6 cells/mL in culture medium.
Activate thrombin by adding 1 mL of CaCl2 (1% w/v in NaCl) to the vial.
Add 59 μL of activated thrombin to the mixture.
Add 59 μL of tranexamic acid to the mixture.
Add 764 μL of culture medium containing 50,000 hFBs/mL to the mixture.
Add 118 μL of fibrinogen to the mixture immediately before use.
Pump 1x PBS with pump 3 through the LCi at 50 µL/min throughout the process.
Pump sacrificial fluid (1x PBS) with pump 2 through the UCi2 at 100 µL/min.
Load the syringe with the pre-gel mixture and place it into pump 1.
Run pump 1 at 200 µL/min to deliver the pre-gel.
Stop pumps 1 and 2 once the pre-gel exits the UCo.
Maintain the chip without removing the tubing at 37 °C for at least 10 minutes.
Pump culture medium through UCi2 overnight using pump 3 at 50 µL/h.
Block UCi1 with a cap.
Check under the microscope that hFBs are spread after 24 hours.
Introduce hKCs with pump 2 through UCi2 at 5 ×·106 cells/mL at 40 µL/min for 1 minute.
Leave the chip overnight at 37 °C in a humidity-saturated incubator.
Pump fresh culture medium through LCi using pump 3 only at 50 µL/min.
Wash the top channel with 1x PBS for 5 min at 50 μL/min to remove culture medium.
Pump air to remove the 1x PBS at 50 µL/min.
Prepare Calcein AM/Ethidium homodimer-1 Kit (Live/Dead) solution by following the manufacturer's instructions.
Pump Live/Dead solution at 50 µL/min for 2 min.
Incubate 30 min at 37 °C in the dark.
Wash top channel by pumping 1x PBS at 50 μL/min for 2 min to remove any remaining reagent.
Observe the sample under the confocal microscope.
Use an excitation wavelength of 495/590 nm and an emission wavelength of 519/617 nm for live and dead cells, respectively.
